AccessKit's crates declare MIT OR Apache-2.0 but omit the workspace-root licence
files from the published crate archives. The two exact upstream files here were
retrieved from commit f3026222559c7f5f46d8f25cb7404de68eb149f0, which is the
`.cargo_vcs_info.json` commit shared by accesskit 0.25.2, accesskit_consumer 0.39.2,
accesskit_windows 0.35.2 and accesskit_winit 0.34.2.

Source: https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit/tree/f3026222559c7f5f46d8f25cb7404de68eb149f0
